text: explicit stage--stage training, declare mutually disjoint season sets allow stage proceed tuning gate freeze gate pass: Downstream stages reject draft, selection-mismatched, identity-mismatched upstream artifacts. governed kit records season selection three stage identities. train_pipeline() remains available high-level compatibility orchestrator.
code: selection <- validate_season_selection(   allD,   training_seasons = setdiff(     sort(unique(allD$season)),     c("2011-12", "2015-16", "2020-21", "2021-22", "2025-26")   ),   exclude_seasons = c("2011-12", "2015-16", "2020-21", "2021-22"),   holdout_seasons = "2025-26",   application_seasons = character() )  m0_tuning <- tune_m0(allD, selection = selection) # Supply the exact M0 grid with check_boundaries = TRUE in a governed # low-level workflow; train_pipeline() performs this gate automatically. validate_m0_tuning(m0_tuning) m0 <- fit_m0(allD, selection, m0_tuning$best_params) |>   freeze_m0(m0_tuning)  m1_tuning <- tune_m1(allD, m0 = m0, selection = selection) validate_m1_tuning(m1_tuning, check_boundaries = TRUE) m1_best <- m1_tuning$best[1, , drop = FALSE] m1_config <- m1_make_params(   k_ref = m1_best$k_ref,   temperature = m1_best$multi_temperature,   rise_weight = m1_best$align_rise_weight,   slope_window = m1_best$slope_window,   slope_weight = m1_best$slope_weight ) m1 <- fit_m1(allD, selection, m0, m1_config) |>   freeze_m1(m1_tuning)  m2_grid <- default_m2_grid() m2_tuning <- tune_m2(allD, selection, m0, m1, grid = m2_grid) validate_m2_tuning(m2_tuning) m2 <- fit_m2(allD, selection, m0, m1, m2_tuning$best_spec) |>   freeze_m2(m2_tuning)  kit <- assemble_kit(m0, m1, m2) validate_page_kit(kit)

title: Grid search ignition detection parameters (OS-aware parallel) — tuneIgnitionGrid
text: evaluation parallelized OS-aware way: - Windows: PSOCK cluster (`parallel::makeCluster()` + `parLapply()`) - Linux/macOS: forked processes (`parallel::mclapply()`) ## Required columns `dat` must contain: - `season`, `weekF`, `phase`, `p`, `p_cls_p`, `y`, `N` ## Truth definition season, "true" ignition week : `iWeek_true = min(weekF[phase == 1])`. ## Scoring parameter set, function computes: - `diff = iWeek_hat - iWeek_true` - `sum_abs = sum(abs(diff))` across seasons (ignoring `NA` diffs) - `max_abs = max(abs(diff))` across seasons (worst-case; `Inf` missing) - `n_miss =` number seasons `iWeek_hat = NA` - `score = sum_abs + lambda * max_abs + miss_penalty * n_miss` Selection lexicographic: 1) minimize `sum_abs` 2) among parameter sets `sum_abs <= min(sum_abs) + sum_tol`, minimize `max_abs` 3) tie-breakers: minimize `n_miss`, minimize `score`

Adds interactive/reproducible expert ignition labeling page_label_ignitions() end--end page_train_workflow() training wrapper. title: PAGe 0.2.0
text: Adds independently guarded M0, M1, M2 lifecycles: validate_season_selection(), stage tuning validators, fit_*(), freeze_*(). Downstream stages require frozen, selection-matched upstream artifacts stable identities. Extends assemble_kit() validate_page_kit() governed-stage provenance tamper checks retaining legacy kit compatibility. Introduces coherent public workflow surveillance-data validation, training, holdout replay, promotion, frozen-kit forecasting, result summaries. Makes frozen-GAM deployment default keeps weekly refitting available explicit compatibility option. Adds refresh full-retune training modes prior-informed adaptive M2 grids, minimum-NLL, one-standard-error, Pareto selection, plus optional conservative candidate racing. Treats 2025-26 external holdout default requires explicit, threshold-based promotion may enter next training cycle. Removes private data-path assumptions. Historical surveillance data must supplied explicitly PAGE_FLU_HIST_FILE.
